svg.text: Fluent Events — DB schema (event = CPT hybrid + WP taxonomies)
Only wp_fe_* tables shown; WP core (posts/meta/users/taxonomy) is referenced, not drawn — see the note + implementation.md. Line colour = the table it points to.

g.text: classify = WP taxonomies: event_type, venue, organizer,
wp_users (red diamond; FK enforced in app, not DB)
images = plain URLs in settings JSON (calendar logo/cover,
event cover) — no attachment FK, no image columns
